description: Real useVisionStore initial-state and transition vectors, confirmed by frontend/src/store/useVisionStore.test.ts during Sprint 8.

vectors.assertion: useProjectStore state (definitionHash, isStale, generationStatus) is byte-identical before and after — confirmed by useVisionStore.test.ts

presentationModeForcesGridAxesOff.note: showGrid/showAxes remain whatever the user set them to in useVisionStore, but ModelViewport.tsx computes the RENDERED showGrid/showAxes as `viewMode === 'technical' && storedValue` — so Presentation mode always visually hides them regardless of the stored toggle, without needing to reset the stored value itself.
